description:
Best Value and Affordable Electric Bicycles for Adults in Canada

GEMINI E-Bike: 20" Fat Tires, Foldable, Fashion-Forward, Eco-Friendly - Unique Design for Teens & Adults

How to Assemble the Foldable GEMINI Electric Bike？https://youtu.be/QzwoXib1igM

20-inch Tire Electric Bike with Foldable FrameThe C INVERTER GEMINI electric bike is specially designed with super professional 3.0 size tire, wear resistant and puncture resistant. Explore nature by cycling freely in the mountains and cities. Or you can experience the feeling of barrier-free flying in the snow, at the beach, etc.

Super Motor, Super Long Range:The GEMINI electric bike is equipped with a 350W 36V motor and can easily complete 25 inclines. The built-in removable 11.6AH battery has a range of about 20-50 miles on a single charge and a battery life of 7-8 hours. If you like excitement and challenge, get on this mountain bike and experience an uninterrupted adventure.

Thoughtful Design:The bike has an aluminum body, low density, high strength, and a net weight of only 56.3 pounds. Foldable design is easy to carry and saves space. Do not underestimate the hollow seat design, it is not only comfortable and breathable, but also to avoid water. The bike also comes with an easy-to-read LCD display (showing battery, range, speed, assistance level, error codes, etc.) as well as headlights and mirrors to keep you safe.

Speed Upgrade:Three riding modes can be selected (pure electric mode, manual mode, power mode), manual mode can realize the 7-speed Shimano transmission system and mechanical transmission gear, experience the strange acceleration experience; In power mode, you will experience the unexpected speed of driving.

Comfortable Shock Absorption:Equipped with front and rear seat dual shock absorbers front suspension, large-capacity low-pressure tires also play the role of additional shock absorbers, more able to maintain balance and handling on rugged mountain roads. Front and rear double disc brakes and electronic brakes to achieve all-round safe driving.
